# SDLC-FR-0401 — Migrate stored events to the new schema without downtime

## Requirement

All stored events must be migrated from the current storage schema to the new one while the service keeps accepting submissions.

## Detailed Behavior

During the migration, submissions and status reads keep working for every producer and consumer. After it, every event is readable in the new schema with its original values.

## Rationale

The new schema is needed for replay, and no outage is acceptable.

## Acceptance / Verification

No submission fails because of the migration; after it, every previously stored event reads back with identical values.

## Constraints & Edge Cases

Several million events are stored; the migration may take days.

## Non-Goals

Does not change the event payload format.

## Open Questions

None.

--- Requirement SDLC-FR-0402 (entity synthetic-402, tree fingerprint 8aefbb4e6cd6e3e62991df27168015823bda24fa02a3f888685f433077f2bdd6) ---
<!-- document: SDLC-FR-0402 — Support event replay for downstream consumers | id: root-402 | parent: root | depth: 0 -->
# SDLC-FR-0402 — Support event replay for downstream consumers

## Requirement

A downstream consumer must be able to replay stored events of a given type from a chosen point in time, in their original order.

## Detailed Behavior

Replay delivers the same events in the same order every time for the same starting point. A consumer can stop and resume a replay without receiving an event twice.

## Rationale

Consumers rebuild their own state after failures.

## Acceptance / Verification

Two replays from the same point deliver identical sequences; a resumed replay neither skips nor repeats an event.

## Constraints & Edge Cases

Several consumers may replay at the same time.

## Non-Goals

Does not define how consumers are registered.

## Open Questions

None.

--- Requirement SDLC-FR-0403 (entity synthetic-403, tree fingerprint 26957a9408eed3f6bc8790570095a0770ebc64942d15fe9102f6495ea137253b) ---
<!-- document: SDLC-FR-0403 — Limit submissions per source | id: root-403 | parent: root | depth: 0 -->
# SDLC-FR-0403 — Limit submissions per source

## Requirement

Submissions must be rate-limited per source identifier so that one source cannot exhaust the service.

## Detailed Behavior

A source that exceeds 100 submissions per second receives an explicit rate-limit refusal for the excess; other sources are not affected.

## Rationale

One faulty producer must not degrade the service for others.

## Acceptance / Verification

A burst from one source above the limit is refused for that source only.

## Constraints & Edge Cases

The limit applies per source identifier, across all instances of the service.

## Non-Goals

Does not define per-tenant quotas.

## Open Questions

None.
